title: Record delivered TermAl independent evaluation, mode selection and evaluation-time source checks
outcome: The delivered host paths (independent and sub_agent evaluators, mode selection, Build and Test observation, evaluation-time source checks) are shown by retained real records and cited source on this item; the undelivered host work (Build-bound proof, project default versus task pin, completion-time fingerprint, and any unretained submission-time measurement) is owned by named TermAl items, and nothing here claims it delivered.
acceptance: A holder note on this item describes mode selection as implemented at a named TermAl source revision, citing the source lines: how the task pin, the admitted project default and the fallback order interact; that independent_session and sub_agent each create a read-only evaluator while same_session returns a brief and spawns nothing; and the admitted modes of each live store's policy, read from the store

A holder note on this item gives complete record ids for a real host independent_session evaluation and the completion seal that consumed it, with the host-carried evaluator identity, model, attempt key and source fingerprint, and for observed Test verification; for Build verification it gives a real host-produced record if one exists among retained records, or states plainly that none was found, citing the delivered Build producer's TermAl item

A holder note on this item shows the source fingerprint recorded at evaluation request, and the submission-time check either as a retained record of that measurement or, where the host retains none, as the cited source that performs it plus a TermAl item that owns retaining or exposing it; and it names the TermAl item that owns each undelivered obligation: Build-bound proof, project default versus task pin, and completion-time fingerprint

completion.summary: Recorded implemented mode selection at the named TermAl revision, read all six live-store policies without mutation, and retained a real host Test/evaluation/consuming-seal chain with full metadata. Documented that no real-task Build verification was found and assigned the unretained measurement and remaining strict proof gaps to confirmed TermAl owners. Independent evaluation 1e88a59ff8c341b4b3fd511cf7b975bf passed all three revision-5 criteria on judgment; its full rationale and stated read-only access limitations were inspected. No source code, configuration, build, installation or restart changed.
